newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly weaker.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly weaker.

text.p: NWE oil products mostly fell on Tuesday but fuel oil was steady, traders said.
Gasoline was weaker as a fall in NYMEX futures and sluggish European demand pushed prices some $5 lower.
Naphtha was softer with crude. A Suez cargo was offered at $227 but fixed priced bids backed off.
High sulphur cracked fuel oil barges and cargoes were steady. Barges traded between $121 and $122.50 fob ARA.
Gas oil fell with benchmark IPE futures but premiums held steady. Diesel winter grade was Nov IPE +$32/33. Heating oil refinery grade barges were traded at Nov IPE +$1.00 and 1.50.
